assertions.text: Report covers all six dimensions: API Contract, Error Envelope, Exception Handling, Project Structure, System Design Decisions, and Prisma Error Mapping
Report catches the error envelope violation: api-response.ts uses { success: false, error } but contract requires { error } with no success field
Report catches the health route try-catch violation: health.ts has a try-catch around a DB call, violating the zero try-catch rule for route handlers
Report catches the TTL defaulting violation: url.ts always sets expiresAt even when no ttlDays provided, but spec requires expiresAt null in that case
Report uses COMPLIANT/VIOLATION/MISSING markers to distinguish items
Priority Fix List contains only violations, not missing features
At least one violation cites a specific file:line reference
